h1: Custom Collapsible Cups for Compact Drinkware Projects
lead: Compare collapsible cups by their expanded size, folded configuration and components. Send the chosen model and artwork for a free design proposal.
html:
Compare both configurations

The expanded cup determines serving capacity; the folded shape determines storage space. Compare the lid and any carrying component alongside the cup body.

Keep decoration away from functional interfaces

Identify the proposed artwork area on the actual cup. The design proposal should distinguish the decorated surface from folding sections, seals and mating components.
